text: Hey. I'm Ricardo. Well, a brick version of him.
I'm a founding engineer at Supahost, where I build the text and voice agents that talk to thousands of guests every month.
On the side I'm building Merkl, so AI agents can move money without ever breaking your rules.
My thesis, ENGRAM, is about how agents remember.
And at HackSpain 2026, my team won the voice-agent track.
Lately I read about AI safety, and computers made of living neurons.
Fun fact: I'm an NFT he bought in 2021. One of his worst investments, so he put me here.
Scroll down for the rest. Soon, you'll be able to just ask me.
